Ranch Salad
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 8:05am

Ingredients




1 medium Head cauliflower, broken
Florets
1 bn Broccoli, broken into
6 smalls Tomatoes, quartered
4 Carrots, thinly sliced
4 Green onions with tops, thinly sliced
1 cup Chopped celery
6 slcs Bacon, cooked and crumbled
4 ounces Shredded cheddar cheese
1 8 ounce bot bleu cheese salad, dressing
8 ounces Ranch salad dressing

Preparation

1 Combine vegetables, bacon and cheese in a large salad bowl. Combine salad dressings; pour over salad and toss to mix. Chill.
